_comment: Real chat message strings, with what the parsers must make of them.
Sources: RuneLite's ChatCommandsPlugin, Dink's test suite, and the patterns both encode.
Colour tags are included on some entries on purpose — the client delivers them, and the
sanitiser has to strip them before any parser sees the line.
Add a case here when a parser surprises you; never fix a parser without adding the message
